subject: Production and Operations Management
notes: Operations core. Numerical answers are stated in correctAnswer with working in explanation.

questions.text: The function concerned with converting inputs into outputs of goods and services is
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.explanation: Production management transforms inputs into valuable outputs.

questions.text: The system that produces standardised goods in large volume is
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.explanation: Mass production makes large volumes of standardised products.

questions.text: The production of goods one at a time to customer specification is called
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.explanation: Job production makes unique items to order.

questions.text: Production management and operations management are entirely different concepts
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.explanation: Operations management is the broader term that includes services as well as goods.

questions.text: List the objectives of production management
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.correctAnswer: Right quality right quantity right time and minimum cost.
questions.explanation: These objectives ensure efficient and customer satisfying production.

questions.text: Explain the scope of production and operations management
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.correctAnswer: The scope covers product design process planning plant location and layout production planning and control quality and maintenance management.
questions.explanation: Cover the activities from design to control and improvement.

questions.text: The decision about where to set up a plant is
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.explanation: Plant location chooses the site for the production facility.

questions.text: The physical arrangement of machines and departments within a plant is the plant
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.explanation: Plant layout arranges facilities for efficient flow of work.

questions.text: A product layout is best suited for continuous mass production
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.explanation: Product layout arranges machines in the sequence of operations for mass output.

questions.text: List the factors affecting plant location
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.correctAnswer: Nearness to raw materials market transport labour power and government incentives.
questions.explanation: These factors influence the cost and convenience of a site.

questions.text: Explain the types of plant layout
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.correctAnswer: Layouts include product layout process layout fixed position layout and cellular layout each suited to different types of production and volume.
questions.explanation: Describe each layout and the production setting it suits.

questions.text: The process of deciding what when and how much to produce is
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.explanation: Production planning determines what and how much to produce and when.

questions.text: The document that lists the materials and operations required to make a product is the
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.explanation: The bill of materials details all components needed for a product.

questions.text: Routing determines the sequence of operations for a job
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.explanation: Routing fixes the path and sequence of operations for production.

questions.text: List the steps in production planning and control
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.correctAnswer: Routing scheduling dispatching and follow up.
questions.explanation: These steps plan and control the flow of production.

questions.text: Explain the importance of production planning and control
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.correctAnswer: Production planning and control ensures optimum use of resources timely delivery reduced costs and smooth workflow by planning scheduling and monitoring production.
questions.explanation: Cover resource use delivery and cost benefits.

questions.text: The function that ensures materials are available in the right quantity at the right time is
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.explanation: Materials management handles procurement storage and issue of materials.

questions.text: The level of inventory at which a new order must be placed is the
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.explanation: The reorder level triggers replenishment before stock runs out.

questions.text: Total quality management makes quality the responsibility of every employee
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.explanation: TQM involves everyone in continuous improvement of quality.

questions.text: List the techniques of inventory control
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.correctAnswer: ABC analysis economic order quantity reorder level and just in time.
questions.explanation: These techniques balance inventory cost with availability.

questions.text: Explain the objectives of quality management
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.correctAnswer: Quality management aims to meet customer requirements prevent defects reduce waste and improve reliability through standards inspection and continuous improvement.
questions.explanation: Cover customer satisfaction and defect prevention.

questions.text: The function that keeps machines and equipment in working condition is
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.explanation: Maintenance keeps plant and machinery in good working order.

questions.text: Maintenance carried out before a breakdown occurs is
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.explanation: Preventive maintenance is scheduled to avoid breakdowns.

questions.text: Work study combines method study and work measurement
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.explanation: Work study analyses methods and measures work to improve efficiency.

questions.text: List the types of maintenance
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.correctAnswer: Breakdown preventive predictive and corrective maintenance.
questions.explanation: These approaches differ in when maintenance is performed.

questions.text: Explain the objectives of work study
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.correctAnswer: Work study improves productivity by eliminating waste simplifying methods and setting fair time standards for planning and incentives.
questions.explanation: Cover method improvement and standard setting.

questions.text: The philosophy of producing only what is needed when it is needed is
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.topic: Lean JIT and supply chain management
questions.explanation: Just in time minimises inventory by producing to demand.

questions.text: The network of organisations involved in producing and delivering a product is the supply
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.topic: Lean JIT and supply chain management
questions.explanation: The supply chain links suppliers producers and distributors.

questions.text: Lean production aims to eliminate waste in all forms
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.topic: Lean JIT and supply chain management
questions.explanation: Lean production continuously removes non value adding activities.

questions.text: List the benefits of just in time production
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.topic: Lean JIT and supply chain management
questions.correctAnswer: Lower inventory reduced waste better quality and faster response to demand.
questions.explanation: JIT cuts costs and improves responsiveness.

questions.text: Explain the objectives of supply chain management
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.topic: Lean JIT and supply chain management
questions.correctAnswer: Supply chain management coordinates suppliers producers and distributors to reduce cost improve service and respond quickly to customers.
questions.explanation: Cover cost service and responsiveness objectives.

questions.text: Assertion: Just in time reduces inventory holding costs. Reason: JIT produces only when demand arises so stock levels stay low
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.topic: Lean JIT and supply chain management (assertion reason)
options: Both assertion and reason are true and reason explains assertion
Both are true but reason does not explain assertion
Assertion is true but reason is false
Assertion is false but reason is true
questions.explanation: Low stock from demand driven production directly cuts holding costs.

questions.text: Match the concept to its focus
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.topic: Lean JIT and supply chain management (matching)
questions.explanation: JIT minimises inventory while lean eliminates waste and quality satisfies customers.

questions.text: The annual demand is 12000 units and each order costs 200. The economic order quantity with holding cost 3 per unit is
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.explanation: EOQ equals the square root of two times demand times ordering cost divided by holding cost so square root of two times 12000 times 200 divided by 3 equals about 1265 units.

questions.text: The time taken by a worker to complete a job is studied in
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.explanation: Time study measures the time required to perform a task.

questions.text: The study of the movements of workers to eliminate unnecessary motion is
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.explanation: Motion study improves methods by removing wasteful movements.

questions.text: Explain the factors determining the choice of production system
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.correctAnswer: The choice depends on product variety volume customer specification and capital requirements with job batch and mass systems suiting different combinations.
questions.explanation: Relate product volume and variety to the production system.

questions.text: Read the case: A garment factory receives large orders for many different styles. Recommend the most suitable production system and justify it
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.correctAnswer: Batch production is best because it handles moderate volumes of many product styles in runs switching between them efficiently.
questions.explanation: Match the variety and volume to batch production.

questions.text: Read the case: A plant faces frequent machine breakdowns that halt production. Recommend a maintenance strategy to reduce downtime
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.correctAnswer: The plant should adopt preventive and predictive maintenance with scheduled inspections and monitoring to fix problems before they cause breakdowns.
questions.explanation: Propose planned maintenance to replace reactive repairs.

questions.text: A factory produces 5000 units in 50 hours. Its production rate per hour is
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.explanation: Production rate equals output divided by time so 5000 divided by 50 equals 100 units per hour.

questions.text: Explain the importance of plant location
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.correctAnswer: Plant location affects cost of raw materials and distribution availability of labour and utilities and long term profitability so it is a strategic and hard to reverse decision.
questions.explanation: Cover cost labour and long term impact of location.

questions.text: Capacity refers to the maximum output a plant can produce in a period
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.explanation: Capacity is the maximum sustainable output per period.

questions.text: Explain the techniques of quality control
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.correctAnswer: Quality control uses inspection statistical quality control control charts and acceptance sampling to detect and correct defects and maintain standards.
questions.explanation: Cover inspection and statistical techniques of quality control.

questions.text: The classification of inventory items into A B and C categories by value is
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.explanation: ABC analysis focuses control on the high value A items.

questions.text: Explain the difference between product and process layout
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.correctAnswer: Product layout arranges machines by the sequence of operations while process layout groups similar machines together by function.
questions.explanation: Product layout suits mass production and process layout suits variety.

questions.text: Explain the steps in purchasing procedure
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.correctAnswer: Purchasing proceeds from identifying the need through supplier selection placing the order receiving and inspecting goods to payment and record keeping.
questions.explanation: Trace the purchasing cycle from requisition to payment.

questions.text: A lead time is the gap between placing an order and receiving the goods
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.explanation: Lead time is the delay between ordering and delivery.

questions.text: Explain the importance of materials management
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.correctAnswer: Materials management ensures uninterrupted production at minimum cost by buying storing and issuing materials efficiently and controlling inventory.
questions.explanation: Cover availability cost and inventory control.

questions.text: List the objectives of maintenance management
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.correctAnswer: Minimise breakdowns reduce downtime extend equipment life and ensure safety.
questions.explanation: These objectives keep production running smoothly.

questions.text: Explain the benefits and limitations of automation
questions.subject: Production and Operations Management
questions.correctAnswer: Automation raises speed consistency and quality and lowers unit cost but requires high capital and skilled staff and reduces flexibility.
questions.explanation: Balance productivity gains against cost and flexibility.
